manual_review.method: Author inspection of the complete documentation diff and branch walkthroughs; not an independent review or live generation experiment.
scenarios: Implement specs/todolist without a named skill routes to Supervisor and allocation before task work.
Ordinary non-spec edits retain direct implementation; plan-only and document-only requests stop before execution.
A full task gets a separate fresh planner, retained implementer and required fresh independent reviewer.
A lightweight task prepares its own plan and separate acceptance, retains source task identity and check evidence, and reports optional review honestly.
Explicit approval/review requirements override lightweight defaults; missing required review blocks acceptance.
Escalation to full preserves existing records and obtains planner preparation and required review.
Mixed task modes preserve prerequisite gates and final independent validation; repairs re-enter task selection and subsequent validation.
Planning defects return to the retained planner or to the lightweight implementer; validation remains independent.
Difficulty: a complex task with fully understood requirements and solution requires full mode; only simple tasks qualify for lightweight mode.
Uncertainty: unresolved requirements block implementation in either mode rather than determine the workflow; changed implementation demands trigger a new difficulty assessment.
manual_review.instruction_review: Shared rules own difficulty-based task selection, mode differences, planning ownership, acceptance and artifact policy. Role routines keep dispatch and repair actions, referencing shared gates instead of restating them. The root routing pointer remains explicit. Each role operates with shared rules, its own routine and MODELS.md; no new files or procedure dependencies.
manual_review.growth_reason: Compared with the starting commit, total instruction words decrease by 125. Shared-plus-role loads remain higher because shared guidance now defines task-level workflow selection; duplicate role instructions were removed while preserving the new policy.

decisions_preserved: Spec implementation always routes to the full project workflow without requiring a named skill.
Implementers assess difficulty; complex tasks require full mode regardless of certainty, and only simple tasks qualify for lightweight.
Mode selection is separate from model routing; unresolved requirements block either mode.
Both modes retain source task IDs, plans, acceptance, evidence, bindings, usage and dependency gates.
Full mode requires separate fresh planning and independent review; lightweight uses its implementer as planning owner unless a planner is assigned.
Explicit review/approval requirements remain binding; omitted optional review is never reported as PASS.
Complexity escalation preserves records and completes full-mode gates; planning corrections return to the defined planning owner.
Independent final validation, repair scheduling, fresh revalidation, resume behavior and historical preservation remain required.
tightening.validation: Author diff inspection and documentation walkthroughs; package structure, links, skill entry points, whitespace and checksums. No live app workflow or independent review claimed.

spec_workflow_routing.limits: Documentation/package validation only. No app workflow was executed, prior .suite artifacts were not repaired, and historical runtime validation claims were not rerun.
